title: TX-9 kinase inhibitor demonstrates activity in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma xenografts
body: TX-9 is a novel tyrosine kinase inhibitor targeting mutant KRAS. Preclinical studies in pancreatic cancer xenografts showed 40% tumor volume reduction at 50 mg/kg daily dosing. Pharmacokinetics showed rapid absorption and hepatic metabolism. This compound is unrelated to ROCK2 inhibition and has no relevance to fibrotic diseases.
